what_this_is: The DATA tools/write-public-share-files reads. Moved from Trillion's src/record-sharing.json (addresses: readable row addresses, sitemap and llms.txt words and bounds), src/space-settings.json (share_from_private.list: the fields a shared List lets out, at every depth) and src/lists.json (field_kinds: which kind of field is a rule that decides what shows, which holds a file, and how the formula engine compares its value). Nothing in code names a field, kind, list or person; these rows do.

row_part.about: A link to one row of a List names the record list:<id>:rows:<row id> (record-sharing.json parts); only that row and the files it names leave.

addresses.llms_about: Lists and records their owners chose to publish. Each entry links to its page; every page names who shared it.

words.not_public: Only a link anyone may open has public files; this one is for named people, an audience or an access code.
words.ended: This link is revoked, expired or not published, so its files are removed.
words.when: This link opens only while its own condition holds, which a file on a public server cannot check at each open.
words.counts_opens: A row of this list shows only after a number of opens, which a file on a public server cannot count.
words.clock: A row of this list shows or hides by the time of day or date, which a file on a public server cannot check at each open.
words.match_only: This link shares a field to match only, which needs the matching service; it is left out rather than shown.
words.not_a_list: Only a List, or one row of it, has public files from this tool.
words.missing: The shared List is no longer in the person's records.
words.rows_not_granted: This List's rows are a kind this run was not granted to read, so it has no files in this folder.
